Do not use a catheter valve if bladder filling could harm the kidneys, such as with a high-pressure, poorly compliant bladder or urine reflux, or when continuous drainage is required. It is also unsuitable if the person cannot reliably operate it or follow an emptying schedule and has no caregiver support. A clinician should assess suitability, particularly with kidney impairment, a small bladder capacity, or recent urinary tract surgery.
